title: Realiti Express 2025 🚀
content:
Realiti Express 2025 🚀



Time flies faster than your VR headset battery 🔋💨
Last year, I joined the first Estonian EEVR meetup.
Now it’s year two — still the same reality, but a little more express. 😎

Last year was like a Titan battle ⚔️ — Apple Vision Pro vs Meta Quest 3.
This year? Meta showed up alone with its Ray-Ban Glasses 😎— and they’re still in “demo mode” (you can try them in-store… if you survive the queue 🕰️).

So yes, this year’s theme is less hardware flex, more software zen. 💻✨



First up, Concept VR — showing how to turn VR into a panoramic documentary machine.



TalTech brought their new Unitree G1 — friend from home.



And yes, here’s The Meta Ray-Ban Display — cool shades, limited pixels. 🕶️✨

Maru VR showed off updates for Bootstrap Island (still PCVR only — Quest users, keep dreaming 🏝️).

Unloop VR brought a slick sci-fi escape room powered by Unreal’s MetaSound and Blueprints.
But honestly... I bet Godot could do the same thing.

Alpha 3D seems to be cooking with Stable DreamFusion to make 3D assets from thin air (or GPU smoke 💨).

And Helsinki XR Centre shared their XR roadmap

Also, there are some defence techs. I am not a war person, and a lot defence techs they do not share so much. So there are not so much to learn.



Dinner spot of the night — serving vibes straight out of 1984.
The head sculpture was watching. Always watching. 👁️🍽️

Unreal Guild 🎨

Then off to another meetup at EKA — the Unreal Guild.
The highlight? Learning about the OKLCH color space 🌈
Here is a good youtube channel shows how color works - color nerd 🎨✨
